note: The crew's recorded strategies for Halvorsen Tower (Owner Mode, #126): src/agents/crew/strategies.ts answers with these in fake mode and when a live call fails. Entry and zone ids are the cached manifest's (data/levels/F1.romaine-1974.json; these strategies are kept per building, so any mission on F1 reuses them).

strategies.name: Dock, after the round
strategies.rationale: Freight lift up, hold until the round passes, then straight down the dock corridor and back.

strategies.name: Dock, straight in
strategies.rationale: Shortest way to the files. Sprint past the corridor camera instead of waiting it out.

strategies.name: Roof, through the vacant suites
strategies.rationale: Down the east stair and keep to the dark, empty suites where nobody patrols.

strategies.name: Dock, by way of Suite 2206
strategies.rationale: Stage in the vacant Suite 2206 first, then come at the records room from the main corridor.

strategies.name: Dock in, roof out
strategies.rationale: In by the dock, out over the roof so nobody waiting at the dock sees us leave.
